Last error: ' ++ vars.failure.message, errorCategory: 'Transient', muleCorrelationId: correlationId, responsePayload: if (vars.failure.detail == null) null else write(vars.failure.detail, 'application/json') }]

set-variable.doc:name: patch: terminal
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { requestStatus: 'Failed - Terminal', attempts: vars.attempt, lastError: vars.failure.code ++ ': ' ++ vars.failure.message, errorCategory: vars.failure.category, muleCorrelationId: correlationId, requestPayload: if (vars.ticket == null) null else write(vars.ticket, 'application/json'), responsePayload: if (vars.failure.detail == null) null else write(vars.failure.detail, 'application/json') }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from modules::TicketMapping output application/java --- now() + ("PT" ++ (backoffSeconds(vars.attempt, p('provisioning.retry.baseDelaySeconds') as Number, p('provisioning.retry.maxDelaySeconds') as Number) as String) ++ "S") as Period
